subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Should this PR remain blocked until a targeted live gateway or Telegram proof shows a recoverable generated-media wake-false miss direct-delivering exactly once, or is the current scheduler coverage plus skipped Mantis fixed flag acceptable for this internal path?
rationale: The code shape appears focused, but the repository proof gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof and the available artifact does not show an observed before/after delivery result.

options.title: Require Targeted Live Proof
options.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted logs, terminal output, or a Telegram/Desktop artifact shows the forced wake-false path delivering one generated media result after the patch.

options.title: Accept Internal Proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the scheduler tests and Mantis internal fixed flag as sufficient for this hard-to-trigger internal path while owning the live-delivery uncertainty.

options.title: Use Proof Stack First
options.body: Pause this implementation until the proof-only stack or equivalent hook produces baseline/candidate evidence for the same generated-media wake-false scenario.

recommendation.title: Require Targeted Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR blocked until redacted logs, terminal output, or a Telegram/Desktop artifact shows the forced wake-false path delivering one generated media result after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent media-route fixes and land-ready verification on the predecessor PR make this the best available proof-sufficiency routing candidate from the history trail.
